SBBWU GPA calculation: GPA = sum of (Grade Point x Credit Hours) for all courses in a semester, divided by total credit hours attempted. CGPA is the same calculation across all semesters cumulatively. Grade scale is 1-4 with 85%+ = A (4.0), 70-84% = B (3.0-3.9), 60-69% = C (2.0-2.9), 50-59% = D (1.0-1.9), below 50% = F. P/F (Pass/Fail) grades for thesis/fieldwork are excluded from CGPA calculation.
